content:
dara: Heads-up: Deploybot prevented promo of release-900 due to immutable-tag conflict in eu registry. Attempted push returned 409 Conflict: tag is immutable. Anyone seen this with our retag flow?

deploybot: publish-check FAIL: tag-immutability: target repo gcr.io/redwood-eu/release attempted to overwrite tag v900 which is immutable according to repo policy. See policy link: https://go/policies/image-tag-immutability

infra-hound: quick note: we enabled tag-immutability for prod repos last quarter. Mirror/retag path must use digest promotion, not reassign tag to an existing digest. If origin used ephemeral tag then the mirror tried to reassign.

sam: TL;DR: CI produced image with ephemeral tag `latest-temp-900` then mirror job attempted to push `v900` tag pointing to the same digest. The target has immutability and disallows changing `v900` even if digest equal.

product: change window ends in 30m. Is there a safe manual path to get this release out without breaking auditability?

jen: options: (1) promote by digest (create a new tag name like `v900-promotion-<ts>`) and update releases to point at that tag (2) if we must keep tag `v900`, we need to unfreeze immutability for that repo (requires infra approval and will be logged) (3) rebuild and push fresh image under `v900` (preserves provenance but costs time).

dara: prefer (1) if product ok updating the release pointer. Does deploybot accept digest-based promotion?

deploybot: Deploybot supports digest promotions. Command: `deploybot approve --image gcr.io/redwood-eu/release@sha256:<digest> --env staging`. Audit will record digest rather than tag. Note: release-notes automation expects stable tag; we'll need to patch release-notes or create a redirect alias.

sam: quick commands we can run now:
```
# find canonical digest in origin
crane digest gcr.io/redwood/release:v900
# create a transient promotion tag in target (non-immutable prefix allowed)
crane tag gcr.io/redwood-eu/release@sha256:abcdef123456 v900-promote-20260321
# then approve by digest
deploybot approve --image gcr.io/redwood-eu/release@sha256:abcdef123456 --env staging --meta promotion:transient-tag
```

product: product OK with transient tag as long as release notes mention it and we revert to `v900` tag semantics in follow-up. We cannot change immutability policy during window.

infra-hound: confirm: changing immutability requires org-security signoff; not happening in 30m. Transient tag route is safest.

dara: proceeding with transient tag path. I'll coordinate with release-notes bot to update the auto-generated note to reference the digest.

deploybot: watch: publish-check waiting for attestation in eu registry. Mirror job requeued with `--promote-by-digest` flag.

jen: monitoring CI mirror. If attestation isn't copied we may need manual cosign in eu account. Manual sign commands (target-account session):
```
cosign sign --key ksm://projects/infra/keys/release-signer gcr.io/redwood-eu/release@sha256:abcdef123456
deploybot approve --image gcr.io/redwood-eu/release@sha256:abcdef123456 --env staging --meta manual-attest:immutable-tag-fallback,operator:dara
```

dara: mirror finished, attestation copied. deploybot: publish-check -> PASS. Promotion allowed by digest.

product: rolling canary started. release notes updated: "Release v900 promoted by digest due to target repo immutability; transient tag deployed and will be reconciled in follow-up." Approved.

sam: follow-up actions: 1) update CI to prefer digest-promotion flow when target repo has immutability, 2) add a guard in mirror-runner to detect immutability 409s and auto-switch to digest promotion, ticket: https://github.com/redwood/infra/issues/1432

jen: adding a short addendum to postmortem: avoid ephemeral `latest-*` tags in CI for release artifacts; use digest pinning and stable release tags at build time.

dara: thanks team. moving notes to #release-postmortems and filing the infra ticket. :white_check_mark:
